contributions.title: Classify every optimal linear second callee in the ordinary wrapper
contributions.claim_excerpt:
## Summary

Scoped written proof with exact finite corroboration. Classifies every optimal linear second callee in Jerry Chen / CubeJerry's fixed ordinary-wrapper interface, over every field and dimension. PR2950 supplies the optimum value and Q=P as an attainer; the new result is the complete equality set.

```text
A = P^2-I, R = Q-P, choose A G A=A
Q is optimal iff Q is invertible and
  im R <= im A, ker A <= ker R, R G R=0
```

Equivalently, the perturbation induces a square-zero endomorphism on V/ker A. For scalar P=lambda I with lambda nonzero and lambda^2 different from 1, every optimal Q is lambda I+R with R^2=0. The exact count is

`sum_r [n choose r]_q [n-r choose r]_q |GL_r(F_q)|`.

At dimension two it is q^2. Thus P=2I over F5 has exactly 25 optimal second maps, each correct on 25 of 625 pairs. Optimal agreement does not give exact interchange or a new kappa.

Only `research/optimal-second-callees/` is added. The proof, verifier and provenance are self-contained. The contribution is produced by Nick Petalas. Credit Jerry Chen / PR2950 for the known optimum; Nick Petalas / PR2808/2786, David Arias / PR2753 and Jose Manuel / PR2697/2899 retain the caller lineage. Square-zero flag counting and block rank elimination are standard techniques.
